recommendation:
**WHICH SHOULD YOU APPLY FOR?**

🔵 **Apply for PM-KISAN IF:**
  • You own farmland in your name
  • You need ₹500/month for farm inputs or household needs
  • You have Aadhaar-linked bank account
  • You are NOT an income tax payer
  • You want FREE money (no repayment)

🟠 **Apply for KCC IF:**
  • You need ₹50,000–₹3,00,000+ for farming
  • You want to buy equipment, improve land, or get working capital
  • You don't mind repaying a loan (at cheap ~4% rate)
  • You are a tenant farmer or sharecropper (PM-KISAN excludes you if land isn't in your name)
  • You want flexible access via RuPay card

⭐ **IDEAL: Apply for BOTH if eligible.** They serve different purposes—PM-KISAN gives regular cash support; KCC gives large credit when needed. One is a grant, one is a loan.
